gap.title: Perfect matching on a 3 by 3 graph: no normal-form circuit of at most 12 gates opens with OR of wires 0 and 1, then AND of wires 2 and 9
gap.statement:
¬ (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 12 ∧
    (∀ x : Fin 9 → Bool, C.eval (List.ofFn x) = ((x 0 && x 4 && x 8) || (x 0 && x 5 && x 7) || (x 1 && x 3 && x 8) || (x 1 && x 5 && x 6) || (x 2 && x 3 && x 7) || (x 2 && x 4 && x 6))) ∧
    C.output + 1 = 9 + C.size ∧
    (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length,
      ((C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧
          ∃ a, a < 9 + j.val ∧ (C.gates.get j).inputs = [a]) ∨
      (((C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨
          (C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧
          ∃ a b, a < b ∧ b < 9 + j.val ∧ (C.gates.get j).inputs = [a, b])) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length,
      (∃ x y : Fin 9 → Bool,
        (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (9 + j.val) false ≠ (C.wires (List.ofFn y)).getD (9 + j.val) false) ∧
      ∀ k, k < 9 + j.val → ∃ x : Fin 9 → Bool,
        (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (9 + j.val) false ≠ (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD k false) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length, j.val + 1 < C.gates.length →
      ∃ k : Fin C.gates.length, j.val < k.val ∧ 9 + j.val ∈ (C.gates.get k).inputs) ∧
    C.gates.head? = some ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or, [0, 1]⟩ ∧
    C.gates.tail.head? = some ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and, [2, 9]⟩)
gap.sketch: A proof is one explicit counterexample to the positive statement L-meta-27590; none is expected if that statement is true.
